comment: Production dependencies with known advisories that this server does not execute. Anything NOT listed here fails the Security workflow, and so does a NEW advisory id against a listed package -- the `advisories` array is what somebody actually reviewed, so a fresh one has to be looked at rather than inheriting the exemption. Review the reasons whenever the SDK is upgraded: an entry stops being true the moment src/ imports an HTTP transport. A package this server DOES execute belongs in `overrides` at a fixed version, never here: axios and fast-uri are both live, so they are pinned past their advisories instead of waived.
